searchText: We should have a lobbying channel if we want to allow it. <@755590043632140352> you beat me to the writeup :-), but mine is arriving soon too. And I'm fully in on getting rid of the stone age large message forwarding we use (just check any of my presentation from the last 2+ years, I said it soo many times). DAS was a hard problem compared to this. From my side, it is a no-brainer for H. (The complexity is such that we could even do in G if we would really want to.)

excerpts.content:
<@755590043632140352> you beat me to the writeup :-), but mine is arriving soon too.

And I'm fully in on getting rid of the stone age large message forwarding we use (just check any of my presentation from the last 2+ years, I said it soo many times). DAS was a hard problem compared to this.

From my side, it is a no-brainer for H.  (The complexity is such that we could even do in G if we would really want to.)
